items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Well Conte and I have been doing very well together as The Brothers

ctx.x: It’s just an amazing list, and along with the albums the people that you’ve been involved with musically. It’s quite impressive.

Really, I’ve been so fortunate. I think most musicians, I would do it whether it was worthwhile or if I was starving, the same thing. You do it because you love music. And so it’s been a real privilege as I remember my father, our father, you punch a clock early in the morning, you come home, and it’s cold winters and everything, and he decided like Conte and I were going to be a little different than hanging around working in a factory, which is very commendable because they’re wonderful people, really. And they…
He wanted something different for you?
